national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Growing India-France Strategic and Cultural Ties at Paris Temple Inauguration
bullets: PM Narendra Modi virtually addressed the inauguration of the BAPS Swaminarayan Hindu Mandir in Paris, describing the partnership as 'Made in India and Built in France'.
Both nations are celebrating the ongoing year as the 'India-France Year of Innovation', focusing on AI, defense, space, technology, and climate action.
The Prime Minister emphasized historical and spiritual connections, noting the contributions of French scholars to Sanskrit and spiritual links through ISKCON and Aurobindo Ashram.

national_news.title: ISRO Clarifies Space Sector Reforms Focus on Ecosystem Expansion, Not Privatization
bullets: ISRO clarified that recent space sector reforms aim to build a larger, globally competitive ecosystem rather than privatize the agency or diminish its role.
Private sector participation will allow industry to scale mature technologies and commercialization, expanding India's global market presence.
The division of operational tasks allows ISRO's scientific workforce to focus on high-end research, next-generation technologies, and complex national space missions.

national_news.title: Vice President Addresses Golden Jubilee of Geetanagar College in Assam
bullets: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan addressed the Golden Jubilee celebrations of Geetanagar College in Guwahati, emphasizing youth empowerment and anti-drug advocacy.
Highlighted Assam's economic growth, noting a 45% expansion in the state economy over the past five years and a 54% increase in per capita income between 2021-22 and 2024-25.
Reiterated the goal of Viksit Bharat by 2047, stressing that inclusive development in the North East is essential for national progress.

national_news.title: IAF Sarang Team Participates in Egypt's El Alamein International Airshow
bullets: The Indian Air Force's (IAF) Sarang Helicopter Display Team is participating in the 2nd edition of the El Alamein International Airshow in Egypt.
The team flies the indigenously designed and manufactured Advanced Light Helicopter (ALH) Dhruv and will debut a new manoeuvre named 'Spot Stall Turn' alongside its famous 'Dolphin Leap'.
Formed in 2002, Sarang is recognized as the world's only five-helicopter display team and made its international debut at Singapore in 2004.

national_news.title: Indore Metro Priority Corridor-2 Inaugurated, Network Expands to 17 Km
bullets: Union Housing and Urban Affairs Minister Manohar Lal and MP Chief Minister Mohan Yadav inaugurated the 11-km Priority Corridor-2 (Reach-II) of the Indore Metro.
Developed at an estimated cost of Rs 2,850 crore, the new stretch extends from Super Corridor-3 to Malviya Nagar Chauraha across 11 stations.
With this expansion, Indore Metro's operational network covers approximately 17 km with 16 stations, bringing the total cumulative project cost to Rs 4,370 crore.

national_news.title: 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards Held in Chandigarh
bullets: The 16th National Meet of State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs) and UT Biodiversity Councils (UTBCs) was organized by the National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) in Chandigarh.
Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav urged states to align local governance mechanisms with the Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023, and Biological Diversity Rules, 2024.
The conference focused on dynamic local-level planning through People's Biodiversity Registers (PBRs) and Biodiversity Management Committees (BMCs) to protect local traditional knowledge.

national_news.title: PM Addresses Centenary Celebrations of SRCC, Highlights Economic Progress
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) in New Delhi, highlighting India's position as the fastest-growing major economy with a 7.8% quarterly growth rate.

Key statistics cited include smartphone exports crossing ₹2.5 lakh crore, domestic defense production reaching nearly ₹2 lakh crore, and defense exports surging from ₹600-700 crore in 2013-14 to ₹40,000 crore.
Highlighted infrastructure development speed, noting that railway network electrification increased from under 30% in 2014 to nearly 100% within 12 years.

national_news.title: India to Host Inaugural iBRICS Summit Alongside 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi
bullets: Over 500 institutional investors, finance ministers, and business leaders will attend the inaugural iBRICS Summit in New Delhi, organized alongside the 18th BRICS Summit.

The summit aims to connect sovereign capital with infrastructure, energy, and digital projects, as well as discuss non-dollar settlements and interoperability between payment systems like India's UPI and Brazil's Pix.
India holds the BRICS Chairship for 2026 under the theme 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Reviews Airfare Regulation and Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 Rules
bullets: The Supreme Court heard a plea seeking regulatory guidelines to control unpredictable airfare fluctuations and ancillary charges imposed by private airlines.
The Union Government informed the court that rules under the new Bharatiya Vayuyan Adhiniyam, 2024 are being fast-tracked to modernize the aviation sector.
The petition highlights the need for an independent regulator to enhance transparency and passenger protection across the civil aviation industry.

bihar_news.title: Vice President Launches India's First National Heart Valve Registry in Chennai
bullets: Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the 'India Valve Registry' during the 9th edition of the India Valves 2026 conference held in Chennai.
The registry functions as a multicentre national database collecting secure, de-identified real-world clinical data on heart valve interventions across Indian hospitals.
It provides India's first continuous national platform to document regional clinical variations, patient demographics, and long-term treatment outcomes for structural heart disease.

bihar_news.title: India's Progress in Tuberculosis Elimination through Indigenous Innovation
bullets: According to the WHO Global TB Report 2025, India’s TB incidence declined by 21% from 237 to 187 cases per lakh population between 2015 and 2024.

During the same period, TB mortality fell by 25% and treatment coverage improved from 53% to 92%, supported by initiatives like the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP) and Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana.

Key institutions driving indigenous research and diagnostics include the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), National Institute for Research in Tuberculosis (NIRT), and Department of Biotechnology (DBT).

bihar_news.title: Finance Ministry Data Highlights Status of PM Jan Dhan Yojana Accounts
bullets: According to Finance Ministry RTI data, over 59.03 crore PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) accounts hold a total balance exceeding ₹3.15 lakh crore as of August 2026.
Around 15.36 crore accounts (26%) are inoperative, with Uttar Pradesh having the highest at 3.23 crore, followed by Bihar with 1.59 crore accounts.
Over 5.72 crore accounts currently have zero balance, while total accounts are highest in Uttar Pradesh (10.51 crore), Bihar (7.01 crore), and West Bengal (5.73 crore).

bihar_news.title: NHSRCL Proposes 1,170 km Delhi-Bihar High-Speed Rail Corridor
bullets: The proposed 1,170 km Delhi-Uttar Pradesh-Bihar High-Speed Rail Corridor aims to reduce travel time between Delhi and Patna from 12-15 hours to 4.5 hours.
Executing agency NHSRCL has planned a design speed of 350 km/h and an operational speed of 320 km/h for the project.
Major intermediate stations proposed along the route include Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj, and Varanasi.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Establish 700 Model Schools and Dedicated Teacher Training University
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced the setting up of around 700 Saraswati Vidya Niketan Model Schools across the state to offer competitive coaching for NEET and JEE.
A dedicated Teacher Training University will be established to upgrade the skills of over 7 lakh teachers spanning primary, higher, engineering, and polytechnic education.
The state government plans to build a modern artificial intelligence ecosystem in partnership with major tech firms including Google, Microsoft, and Sarvam AI.

bihar_news.title: IIT Madras Patents Chemical-Free Antibacterial Surface to Combat AMR
bullets: Researchers at IIT Madras have patented a purely mechanical, chemical-free antibacterial surface that physically ruptures bacterial cell walls to fight Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR).
The technology utilizes nanoscale 'nanograss' structures fabricated on implant-grade silicone via a low-pressure Reactive Ion Etching process.
Laboratory testing achieved over 68% inhibition of biofilm formation while preserving mammalian fibroblast cell viability up to 91%.

bihar_news.title: NMC Grants Approval for Two New Medical Colleges in Bihar
bullets: The National Medical Commission (NMC) granted Letters of Permission (LoPs) for two new medical institutions in Bihar starting in the 2026-27 session.
The new institutions are Government Medical College in Chhapra (Saran) and Ram Janki Medical College and Hospital in Samastipur.
Each institution will start with an intake capacity of 50 MBBS seats, adding a total of 100 medical seats in the state.

bihar_news.title: Cross-Border Himalayan River Management and Nepal-India Floods
bullets: Highlights the transboundary nature of Himalayan river systems affecting Bihar and Uttar Pradesh, emphasizing that disasters like floods do not recognize political boundaries.
References historical events such as the 2008 Kosi catastrophe to underline the limitations of domestic engineering and poorly maintained embankments.
Calls for cooperative risk management, real-time monitoring across vulnerable catchments, and joint forecasting models between India and Nepal.

bihar_news.title: India-Nepal Transboundary Cooperation Needed for Himalayan Flood Management
bullets: Highlights the transboundary nature of flood risks between Nepal, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh due to the shared Himalayan river system, including the vulnerable Kosi river basin.
Advocates shifting from reactive engineering solutions like embankments to proactive joint risk management, including real-time monitoring and joint forecasting models.
Emphasizes institutional cooperation for sharing data on sediment loads, changing river channels, glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs), and structural conditions of barrages to protect North Bihar.
